statement: An app change lists the tenants a widened permission policy reaches as one informational entry per policy, counted from the back-reference index, without reading a tenant document; that entry never stands in for an escalation that needs approval: only TENANT_BINDINGS is informational, and an approval must still cover every other escalation.
guards: control:InformationalEscalationTest#only the tenants' entry and the role class's record are informational
control:InformationalEscalationTest#an aggregated tenant entry never stands in for the approval the widening needs
control:ChangesB1Test#widening an app permission policy lists the tenant bindings it widens - RC1-34
control:RoleClassUnitTest#what the analysis could not tell still waits, whoever holds what - CTL-79
control:RoleClassTest#the class sees every escalation of the change, the analysis's and the others' - CTL-79
